overview_description.description: mdhub is the operating system (EHR & CRM) and AI workforce for behavioral health, enabling providers to automate documentation, patient engagement, intake, scheduling, billing, and care coordination. By combining AI agents with clinical workflows, mdhub helps organizations reduce administrative burden, improve outcomes, and scale access to mental health care.

about_short_description.short_description: mdhub is the operating system and AI workforce for behavioral health, automating care and operations.

product.name: Clinical AI Assistant
product.description: An AI tool that generates clinical notes, patient summaries, and treatment plans for mental health clinicians by processing audio recordings of patient sessions.

product.name: AI Intake Coordinator
product.description: An AI-driven system that automates patient intake by collecting information, pre-screening, documenting, and managing patient communication to streamline clinic operations.

product.name: Custom Templates
product.description: User-configurable templates that allow clinicians to tailor clinical notes and documentation to their preferred style and specific needs.

product.name: Questionnaires Automation
product.description: A feature that automates the summarization and scoring of clinical questionnaires used in mental health assessments.

product.name: Treatment Plans Automation
product.description: A tool that generates and tracks treatment plans automatically based on clinical session data and patient progress.

product.name: Session Handouts Automation
product.description: A service that automatically generates session handouts to provide patients with relevant information and support materials after appointments.
